title: An Adaptive Transfer-Learning-Based Deep Cox Neural Network for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Prognosis Prediction
summary: TCGA training and three independent GEO tests support robustness; the study identifies markers including TTC36 and reports cell experiments. Independent datasets and cell assays support the study-specific result, not treatment efficacy or prospective patient benefit.
ai_technology: An adaptive transfer-learning deep Cox network selects pretraining cancer types and predicts hepatocellular-carcinoma survival from expression data.
organization: School of Mathematics and Big Data, Foshan University, China
